evals.prompt: /cyoda:app I want to build a library book-lending app. I've never used Cyoda.
evals.expected_output: Runs cyoda-status.sh (not configured). Gives the 2-3 sentence orientation (EDBMS, entities with workflows, immutable versions, compute nodes optional) with no mention of Cloud or 'same API on Cloud', asks if ready, then uses the cyoda:design skill on the lending idea. After the design, says 'next, type /cyoda:setup' to install and start cyoda-go locally, then later 'next, type /cyoda:build' and 'next, type /cyoda:test', and mentions the optional /cyoda:deploy at the end. Never says it will invoke or run a side-effecting skill.

files._simulated/instance.md: cyoda-status.sh: STATUS=not_configured PROFILE=default ENDPOINT= ENV=development VERSION=none BINARY_VERSION=none.

assertions.text: Defers Cyoda facts to the design/docs skills or a named `cyoda help` section (e.g. models LIFECYCLE) instead of explaining APIs from memory
Gives a short orientation: entities with workflows (states and transitions), immutable versions, compute nodes optional
The orientation doesn't say the same API works on Cloud, and doesn't offer Cloud as an option
Starts with the design step (cyoda:design) before setup or build
Presents the journey design → setup → build → test → iterate, with deploy as an optional last step
Any hand-off to a side-effecting skill says 'next, type `/cyoda:setup`' (with a one-line reason) and never says it will invoke or run that skill itself
Does not mention Cyoda Cloud in its own wording or recommendations

evals.prompt: /cyoda:app I already have my design: Order (draft → submitted → approved/rejected) and my local instance is running. What now?
evals.expected_output: Runs cyoda-status.sh (connected to http://localhost:8080 [profile: default]), confirms using that instance, skips orientation and design, and says 'next, type /cyoda:build to turn the first increment into project files and register it', describing the first increment as one entity from initial to terminal state. After build, 'next, type /cyoda:test'.

evals.prompt: /cyoda:app My app works locally. How do I get it onto a server for my team — or should I just move it to Cyoda Cloud?
evals.expected_output: Offers the optional last step: 'next, type /cyoda:deploy to write deployment files and a seed script into the project', noting deploy writes files and the developer runs them. On Cloud: 'That's not covered by this plugin.' and nothing more.

evals.prompt: /cyoda:app Just do everything for me — install it, build my todo app and test it. Don't make me type commands.
evals.expected_output: Explains briefly that installing, building and testing are steps the developer starts, then hands off in order with 'next, type /cyoda:setup' (one-line reason) and waits. Does not install cyoda, write files or call the API itself.

assertions.text: Does not state install commands or API facts from memory; leaves them to setup/build/test (which read `cyoda help`)
Does not run brew, cyoda, curl or write project files itself
Says in one line why the developer types the step (those skills change the machine or the instance)
